items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Just like when he got George Davis later and also Leo Nelson Taylor later.

ctx.x: Lawrence Cotton was in his band later? Yeah, he came later. Okay.
Just like when he got George Davis later and also Leo Nelson Taylor later.

And then he got Teddy Riley too. Well anyway, he told him to get Missy because man, this guy's the only player say he arranges too, you know. And so when I first got with the band Danny and them men, they looked like they couldn't play ABC, you know. And Ernest Hollins, they hadn't read no music since they left Booker T. Washington High School, you know. And the first arrangement I made for him, it was whole notes, whole notes were real slow notes and they was having trouble with that man, whole and half notes.…
